text: ＊　ポケモンずかんを　みごと　かんせい　させた　いだいなこうせきを　たたえ　ここに　しょうめい　します

structure.jp: ＊　ポケモンずかんを　みごと　かんせい　させた
いだいなこうせきを　たたえ
ここに　しょうめい　します

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンずかんを　みごと　かんせい　させた　いだいなこうせき
patterns.explanation: The whole phrase ending in させた sits in front of こうせき and tells you which achievement it is. ポケモンずかんを　みごと　かんせい　させた　いだいなこうせき = 'the great achievement of splendidly completing the Pokédex'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる after an action word says you make that thing happen. かんせい alone is 'become complete', so かんせい　させた = 'brought to completion, completed'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: たたえ　ここに　しょうめい　します
patterns.explanation: The verb is cut short to たたえ instead of たたえて; this is the formal written way to join one action to the next, as on a certificate. たたえ　ここに　しょうめい　します = 'praising it, we hereby certify this'.
